newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thais okay rise in condominium foreign ownership.
newsitem.headline: Thais okay rise in condominium foreign ownership.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday approved an interior ministry proposal to allow foreign ownership in condominiums to rise to 100 percent from an existing 40 percent, a government spokesman said.
The move is part of the government's attempt to help shore up the battered property sector, the spokesman told reporters.
"The increase in the foreign ownership limit will help add new demand for the completed condominiums, which faced oversupply situation," he said.
Analysts say it could take up to five years for the market to absorb the oversupply in the condominium sector of the Bangkok property market.
